title: 2001 HMMT February Team Problem 3
statement: What is the 18 th digit after the decimal point of \(\frac{10000}{9899}\) ?

solutions.text: \(\frac{10000}{9899}\) satisfies \(100(x-1)=1.01 x\), so each pair of adjacent digits is generated by adding the previous two pairs of digits. So the decimal is \(1.01020305081321345590 \ldots\), and the 18 th digit is 5 .
